data.name: Manshoor
data.gender_notes: Manshoor is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘sh-r-a’, meaning confirmation or approval. This name signifies a person who is steadfast in their beliefs and actions, and is known for their unwavering commitment to their word. The name Manshoor carries the meaning “Confirmed, Approved, Guaranteed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Manshoor usually hope their child will grow to embody confirmed, approved, guaranteed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
